references.text: Continuation of the purification laws detailing how metals and other materials are to be cleansed with fire or water
Concerns impurity that comes upon objects made of wood, clothing, leather, or sacks, and how they become unclean
Detailed regulations regarding leprosy in garments of wool, linen, or leather, and how they are to be cleansed or burned
Regulations concerning the cleansing of clay vessels and wooden vessels that have become unclean
Purification laws related to dead bodies that affect everything in a tent, including open containers
Use of hyssop and cleansing with water for objects and persons who have become unclean
